bossinfo.title: THE GLASS MOURNER
bossinfo.sub: She weeps for faces that are not hers
bossinfo.victory: The mirrors go dark. Something in them was grateful.

bossinfo.title: THE MOTHER OF MOTHS
bossinfo.victory: The dark wings unravel into a thousand small and harmless moths.

bossinfo.title: ASHMAW THE CHAINED
bossinfo.sub: The wyrm the Iron Brother kept on a leash
bossinfo.victory: Ashmaw is dead. The chains finally go quiet.
